wind.direction: Normalized horizontal world downwind vector. In Blender (dx,dy,0); in RealityKit (dx,0,-dy). Map a zero vector to strength=0.
wind.reduceMotion: Set motionScale=0 for a still neutral pose.
wind.clockSeconds: Elapsed effect time in seconds, continuous across sample calls.
wind.phaseRad: Stable per-instance value in [0,2pi), e.g. stable seeded random.
wind.yaw: Inverse instance rotation transforms world downwind into plant space.
wind.root: Root remains identity. Stem and distal joint rotate in local rest coordinates.
wind.local_bend_axis: normalize(upLocal cross downwindLocal), then inverse joint rest basis rotates the axis into bone-local coordinates.
wind.angleRadians: radians(maxAngleDegrees[j]) * strength * motionScale * response * (0.71 + 0.29*sin(2*pi*clockSeconds/periodSeconds + phaseRad - j*0.43))
wind.cueTiming: Supply an early visual strength ramp from the runtime if needed. The S3 preview marker at local frame 28 represents a demonstration.
